description: This file implements a GStreamer plugin element for Rialto Web Audio Sink, handling audio streaming, state changes, and communication with Rialto server components.

classes.name: RialtoWebAudioSink
classes.description: A GStreamer element for Rialto Web Audio Sink, managing audio data flow and state transitions.

methods.name: rialto_web_audio_async_start
methods.description: Initiates an asynchronous state transition for the Web Audio Sink.

methods.name: rialto_web_audio_async_done
methods.description: Marks the completion of an asynchronous state transition.

methods.name: rialto_web_audio_sink_eos_handler
methods.description: Handles End-Of-Stream (EOS) events, posting appropriate GStreamer messages.

methods.name: rialto_web_audio_sink_error_handler
methods.description: Posts an error message to the GStreamer pipeline.

methods.name: rialto_web_audio_sink_rialto_state_changed_handler
methods.description: Handles state change notifications from the Rialto server, managing GStreamer state accordingly.

methods.name: rialto_web_audio_sink_setup_supported_caps
methods.description: Sets up supported caps (capabilities) for the sink element.

methods.name: rialto_web_audio_sink_send_event
methods.description: Handles events sent to the sink pad, such as EOS and CAPS.

methods.name: rialto_web_audio_sink_change_state
methods.description: Manages state transitions of the GStreamer element, coordinating with the WebAudioClient.

methods.name: rialto_web_audio_sink_event
methods.description: Handles incoming events on the sink pad, such as EOS and CAPS, and interacts with WebAudioClient.

methods.name: rialto_web_audio_sink_get_property
methods.description: Retrieves properties of the Web Audio Sink, currently only logs unsupported properties.

methods.name: rialto_web_audio_sink_set_property
methods.description: Sets properties of the Web Audio Sink, currently only logs unsupported properties.

methods.name: rialto_web_audio_sink_chain
methods.description: Pushes new audio samples to the WebAudioClient.

methods.name: rialto_web_audio_sink_initialise_sinkpad
methods.description: Initializes the sink pad with event and chain functions.

methods.name: rialto_web_audio_sink_init
methods.description: Initializes the Web Audio Sink element, including private data and sink pad.

methods.name: rialto_web_audio_sink_finalize
methods.description: Finalizes and cleans up the Web Audio Sink element.

methods.name: rialto_web_audio_sink_class_init
methods.description: Sets up class-level properties, metadata, and function pointers for the GObject class.
